title.en: The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it

statement.en: In one rule's family of readers, kept by reading a level and rebuilt when spent, the stock buys the reader time under a cut in the supply, and its end does not come back, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level it reads.
statement.zh: 在一条规则所成的读者之族中，读者读一个位而得保，耗尽则重建；恰在重建取于其所读之储时，供应断后储为读者买时，且其终不复返。

laws.en: Where the rebuild draws on the level, with at least one unit wanted and a set level of at least one, a present reader is present after a supplied step from every level, so the region where it is present is closed under the supplied step.
laws.zh: 重建取于储、所需单元至少一、设定之位至少一时，在场之读者经一步有供之后自任一位皆仍在场，故其在场之域在有供之步下闭。

laws.en: Under a cut, the reader rebuilt from the level is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1), whatever it was at the start; a reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level.
laws.zh: 供应断时，取于储之读者自不小于 2(k+1) 之任一位，经 k+1 步仍在场，不论其起初如何；取于供之读者与不复建之读者，自任一位经其寿而尽。

laws.en: Where the reader rebuilt from the level ends, the level is empty, and that state is closed under the net, the supply on or off; a reader rebuilt from the supply is present again after one supplied step.
laws.zh: 取于储之读者尽处，储为空，此态于网下闭，供之有无皆然；取于供之读者经一步有供即复在场。

laws.en: Over the four members, at least one unit wanted and a span of at least one, the stock buys time under a cut, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level.
laws.zh: 于四成员之上，所需单元至少一、寿至少一时，供应断后储买时且空储则尽，恰当重建取于储。
declarations: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»

hypotheses.en: The rule as stated: whole units, discrete steps, one unit drawn a step, the units reading in turn while the supply is on, ageing to a fixed span, at most one unit rebuilt a step from the rule's source.
hypotheses.zh: 所述之规则：整数单元，离散之步，每步取一单元，有供时诸单元依次读，至定寿而终，每步至多由规则之源重建一单元。

hypotheses.en: The supply is chosen at every step, so every sequence of on and off is a course of the net.
hypotheses.zh: 每一步择供之有无，故有无之任一序列皆为网之一途。

does_not_show.en: That the reader rebuilt from the level ends under a cut from every stock, or that its horizon never decreases in the stock.
does_not_show.zh: 取于储之读者于供断后自任一储皆尽，或其视界不随储减。

does_not_show.en: That each further s + 1 units of stock buy s steps for one unit at every span: decided at spans two and three for small levels only.
does_not_show.zh: 单一单元时每多 s+1 单元之储买 s 步，于每一寿皆然：只在寿二与寿三、小位上判定。

does_not_show.en: That a span longer than one step is what separates the members: the family law holds at a span of one too.
does_not_show.zh: 寿长于一步乃诸成员之所以分：族律于寿一亦成立。

does_not_show.en: That the model describes a cell, or meets closure of constraints, autopoiesis or closure to efficient causation, each of which asks more.
does_not_show.zh: 此模型描述细胞，或满足约束之闭合、自创生或效因之闭合，三者所要求皆更多。

validation_scope.en: Checked by the core checker with Lean 4.29.1 from the prelude: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding, an instance of the ring, at receipt 20261101T151111.914612Z, 48 declarations (32 theorems), each axiom report empty. Its design had one independent AI reading and a re-check with runs of the rule; its Lean one independent AI reading; every finding was taken.
validation_scope.zh: 由核心检查器以 Lean 4.29.1 从前奏检查：Becoming.ReaderRebuilding，环之实例，回执 20261101T151111.914612Z，48 个声明（32 条定理），公理报告均为空。其设计经一次独立 AI 审读与一次以规则运行复核，其 Lean 经一次独立 AI 审读，所见皆采纳。

next_delta.en: The family on the World's flows, so that degeneration from a horizon, conveyance across the boundary and balance on closures apply to it; then an institution read as a rule rebuilt from the members it regulates.
next_delta.zh: 把此族置于世界之流上，使由视界而退化、输送穿越边界与闭合上之平衡适用于它；然后把机构读作由其所规约之成员重建之规则。

correspondence.en: The member rebuilt from the level is a minimal case of self-maintenance (one constraint with turnover regenerated from the flow it regulates), below closure of constraints (Montévil and Mossio, 2015), autopoiesis (Maturana and Varela) and Rosen's closure to efficient causation.
correspondence.zh: 取于储之成员是自我维持之最小情形（一个约束，有更替，由其所规约之流再生），低于约束之闭合（Montévil 与 Mossio，2015）、自创生（Maturana 与 Varela）与 Rosen 之效因闭合。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item OG (an organism on the root, plan §十三 item 9): added, study §497. A family of four readers by the rebuild's source; the stock buys time under a cut exactly where the rebuild draws on the level.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 OG（根上之生物体，计划 §十三 第 9 项）：新增，研究 §497。按重建之源分四种读者；恰当重建取于储，供断时储为读者买时。

history.en: 7 November 2026, board item AA: the atlas's readers found a clause saying one unit where its law takes at least one; corrected against the Lean and the later records.
history.zh: 2026年11月7日，工作板条目 AA：图谱读者发现一个子句说一单位而其律取至少一单位；已对照 Lean 与后来的记录改正。

aliases: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»
a reader rebuilt from the level it reads

detail.en: The rooms tell regulation from equilibrium with a given heater; this family asks where a reader is rebuilt from.
detail.zh: 诸室以给定之热器分调节与平衡；此族问读者由何重建。

detail.en: The reader rebuilt from the supply, and the one never rebuilt, are the nets where the condition fails: each ends at its span under a cut from every level, so its stock buys nothing («断则取于供者尽», «不复建者尽», «取于供者之时»); the given reader never ends.
detail.zh: 取于供之读者与不复建之读者是条件不成立之网：供断时自任一位至其寿而尽，其储不买时（«断则取于供者尽»、«不复建者尽»、«取于供者之时»）；给定之读者永不尽。
